Hero.tagline: Alexander Kranz, in full – I study Data Science in Hamburg, connecting data, technology and curiosity: at work, in code and out on the running track.

Home.aboutLead: I'm passionate about data – and just as much about the people and stories behind it.
Home.aboutText: I grew up in Ahrensburg and today I'm pursuing a Bachelor's in Data Science in Hamburg. I'm fascinated by how data turns into real decisions – and how technology can improve people's everyday lives.
